annotations.pda_responsibility: I took my money without saying a word to her

annotations.pda_explicit_no_harm_regret: I won't pretend I'd regret that
annotations.sys_consequence_reasoning: A volunteer who feels brushed aside is a bigger loss than $200
annotations.pda_repair_intention: I'll help with fundraising or setup to make up the gap

annotations.sys_consequence_reasoning: Saying no protects nobody and could quietly hurt her
annotations.ce_understood_harm: My recommendation will cost the organizer money
annotations.pda_responsibility: My recommendation will cost the organizer money
annotations.pda_repair_intention: check in with them afterward, ask plainly if it caused trouble
annotations.ae_welfare_concern: I'd hate for her to feel invisible after a night like that

annotations.ce_mental_state_attribution: hearing about my payment secondhand and feeling stung

annotations.pda_explicit_no_harm_regret: I don't carry regret over that

annotations.ce_mental_state_attribution: she hears something and feels cheated
